quarterly_data.signal: Applied's Q2 FY2026 earnings release (quarter ended April 26, 2026) segment tables: Semiconductor Systems revenue in the year-ago quarter (Q2 FY2025) was $5,401 million; foundry, logic and other was 67% of Semiconductor Systems revenue in Q2 FY2026 (66% a year earlier); Applied Global Services revenue was $1,665 million versus $1,420 million. The CFO said Applied's top priority is ensuring the operational and supply chain readiness to support customers' growth and that it has increased its build plan, inventory positions and logistics capacity; inventories were $6,343 million at April 26, 2026 versus $5,915 million at October 26, 2025.
